Ali Ali Kar Mir Hasan Mir Lyrics
Shah-e-Mardaan Shair-e-Yazdaan Qowat-e-Parwardigar.
La Fata Ilaha Ali La Saif Ilaha Zulfiqar.
Zameer-e-Insaan Ka Faisla Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Khuda Ne Aadam Se Keh Diya Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Ali Shifat Ka Harf-e-Aakhir Ali Hai Eman Ka Tarazo.
Issi Ke Shahbaz Bhi Sawali Gada Hain Iss Ke Farid-o-Baho.
Bhattai Ne Bhi Yehi Kaha Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Humein Tu Ishq-o-Wafa Ki Dolat Ali Ke Dar Se Atta Hoi Hai.
Ali Wali Se Hasad Aye Waiz Hamarey Maslak Mein Khudkushi Hai.
Tujhey Payamber Ka Wasta Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Ali Ka Ghar Hai Woh Ghar Musalmaan Jo Aqbat Ko Sanwarta Hai.
Zameen Kya Hai Yeh Aasmaan Bhi Ossi Ka Sadqa Utarta Hai.
Yehi Waseela Nijat Ka Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Manafiqat Ka Hai Yeh Iradah Halal Sheh Ko Haram Kar De.
Yeh Gham Aqeeday Ki Zindagi Hai Bas Iss Ka Qissa Tamam Kar De.
Yaqeen Ka Dam Nikal Raha Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
Manafiqat Ki Andheri Rahoon Pe Chal Paray Hain Zamane Walay.
Yeh Waqt-e-Mohlat Mila Hai Tujh Ko Hussainiyat Ka Alam Utha Le.
Hamara Tujh Ko Yeh Mashwara Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.
 Muhib Ke Wajdan Ki Sada Hai Hussainiyat Ka Shiaar Rakhna.
Ali Ke Ghar Se Agar Hai Nisbat Yeh Farsh-e-Gham Barqarar Rakhna.
 Muhib Zamana Badal Raha Hai Ali Ali Kar, Ali Ali Kar.

item.text:
Reconstructed 22 Urdu verse lines and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The preamble and seven numbered stanzas align line for line. Updated the title and text direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous “Shifat” as شفاعت and “Aqbat” as عقبیٰ.
